nom: HERBIVORE BLUE TANSY Resurfacing Clarity Mask

avis.texte: I have been using this mask once a week for about five weeks. My skin has never looked more clear or felt smoother. Its working so well that i had to come leave it a good review. I will be repurchasing this! So glad i found it.

I've struggled with acne most of my life, this brand has absolutely saved me. But this mask specifically is a complete and utter game changer. After the acne cleared I was still struggling with texture and blackheads pretty badly. I use this mask up to twice a week and have been doing that for about 3 months now. The difference is insane. My texture is so much better, skin is smooth and has glow (not oily) and the blackheads are way less visible! I finally get compliments on my skin! I don't think I have the most sensitive skin, but I definitely have acne prone and this never once made me breakout or anything negative. I'd definitely recommend it to other, and have!

avis.titre: I was amazed at how much skin loved it
avis.texte: I was getting hormonal acne and had a lot of redness around my nose and chin. I had a sample pack of this product and decided to try it. After two days, all the redness had gone away, and it also cleared up my skin. I loved it so much that I bought the product. I was surprised by how much product you get - I think this will last me for a very long time.

This is a quiet hero! I didn't have any tingling or any signs that it was working. Fast forward to one week and my skin is GLOWING! I'm so used to having reactions with other brands. I didn't have any reactions at all. I just have glowing skin!
I think this product is actually making my pores look smaller and it smells wonderful. I am really enjoying it.
I love this face mask and it has helped so much with my acne! However, it has a horrible smell, it almost smells like taco meat, this is not a dealbreaker though, it has worked wonders!
My skin looks a lot more balanced and the gets rid of a lot of good in my pores. It doesn't dry your skin out like most clarifying masks.Nice herby scent.

This is one of VERY few products I purchase on repeat. My sensitive skin loves it. It helps gently exfoliate without irritating my skin barrier (like almost all other products). I'm 44 with some redness and breakouts, this has become a staple in my routine. 3 times per week for 20 mins (work up to that!) Highly recommend giving it a try.
This isn't as impactful as the old Prism mask, but my pores are visibly shrinking over the last few weeks!
I love the smell, the consistency, the color, the effects. This mask is my favorite and my skin always feels amazing after using it :)

I have pretty sensitive skin that leans towards the dry side, so a lot of the clay based masks just leave my face looking like a crusty desert replete with acne. This is probably my fifth or sixth jar of the Blue Tansy mask and honestly it's become such a holy grail for me. I love the smell and my skin looks and feels so much better after I use it. I usually don't spend more than $15 per skincare/makeup product, but I'll always make an exception for this mask. It lasts for so long and the results are definitely worth it to me!
Bought this for 19 yr old granddaughter who had severe acne, as well as the appropriate cream. It worked wonders!
Love this mask us it every other week for my self care Sunday routine. Helps me with occasional breakouts and follow up with the lapis oil application with a roller ball.
I don't have oily or blemish prone skin, but it works for me. My skin is so soft and glowing afterwards. Will def buy again.
Great product for your face. Such a clean face wash and rinse.
I've only been using it every other day for a week and notice better skin. Doesn't dry my skin!
This mask is really refreshing and seems to be working! Mine is more teal/dark green so if you're buying purely for the color know that it varies.
This mask immediately makes a wonderful difference to the texture of my skin and size of my pores! LOVE it!

One of my favorite finds for my 40yo skin! This truly was a game changer in that it 1 Amazing Aromatics I just really love the earthy-fresh&clean scent when applying 2 Magically gentle RESURFACER I've never experienced a resurfacing/gentle exfoliation withOUT any sort of scrub texture or no stinging or burning. When putting any sort of acid on skin slow and steady is where it's at 3 Easy I like to use this a few times a week in the evenings. Usually on a freshly micellared face, I apply a thin layer for half hour or so & hop in the shower to buff mask away with a konjac sponge. I could go on but I've said plenty. Solid company. Legit products. Actual results. Done!

avis.titre: I Keep Coming Back to It
avis.texte: I ordered this when I was consistently having hormonal acne issues. I swear by it now. I don't know what or how it works, but it does! Now my breakouts are much less frequent, but I immediately reach for this and within a day or so it seems to calm everything down!

This mask is a necessity!! I love the glow after I use it and my skin looks like glass! I have super dry skin but I have zero issues with Over-dryness or tight skin after I wash it off. Everyone needs!

This is one of my favorite products from Herbivore. I'm just a few minutes, your face feels refreshed. I always follow up with the Lapis oil as part of my routine. It works great with my sensitive skin.

Love love this mask!!! I use it asking with the aquarius cleanser and cream and my acne is finally going away!!! I tried so many others and this is the first one that has worked at keeping the pores clean!
Good for reducing my acne flares and works well with my nightly moisturizer rountine.
I can't live without this mask. I notice such a huge difference in tone, pores, redness and inflammation after using this. Holy grail

I LOVE this mask!! My skin was suffering-- I had been in an accident November 2022 and broke my jaw in 3 places. The stress and trauma of it all sent my skin reeling. I had congested and inflamed pores and my skin was so unhappy. I tried products from two other highly rated skin care companies with zero results, then products from a luxurious, "all pure ingredients" company, which unfortunately made my skin even worse!! I can't tell you how many products I've used in the past, many which have rave reviews and devout customers, which have done absolutely nothing for my skin!! I was really desperate; it's bad enough having your jaw reshaped from an accident, at the least I'd like clear skin!! I stumbled upon Herbivore because I was looking for products with Blue Tansy in it. I figured if I can't find anything that actually helps my skin I can at least use something which I like the smell of. Herbivore's prices seemed really reasonable to me (I have spent so much money on really disappointing skin care lines! 😭) so I figured I'd by full size of this blue tansy mask, the aquarius cream, and the aquarius face wash. OMG y'all. This stuff works!! I use the cream am and pm and the wash and mask pm. I saw a small difference the first week, week two there was definite healing going on, and now I am on week five and my skin is clear and happy!!!! I cannot thank Herbivore enough!! My confidence is back!!! And, I just LOOOOVE the blue tansy scent. My absolute favorite!! (Photos of before
This has been a tremendous help with my acne breakouts. It's reduced the visibility of my pores and my skin is softer and more even now.

It's such a delight to use this mask! I love the scent of Blue Tansy and the color, so it feels special and like I'm spoiling myself a bit. It applies smoothly and evenly on the face and doesn't make it feel tight or make my face pulsate like other masks I've tried. I love the gel-like consistency. It tingles just slightly after a few minutes. My skin feels so smooth and soft since using this, and my blemishes have reduced dramatically. A very gentle face mask that really does the job.
Works great and smells great. Immediate results. In love with the whole Aquarius/blue tansy line

avis.titre: Best acne treatment mask I have ever used
avis.texte: I have used this product for 7 years and I can't imagine using anything else. I have always had acne prone skin which got far worse during an IVF cycle, this mask with the Lapis Blue Tansy Face Oil transformed my skin then and has been pretty blemish free ever since.
I've tried every face mask on the planet 🌎 This one is the best! You can see results right after you wash it off. I use it weekly and it makes my skin super smooth, and helps lighten my dark spots.
Great and love the herbal scent I enjoy how blue tansy feels on my skin as it is drying

So I was eagerly waiting to get this item in the mail, when it arrived (see photo) it was kind of leaked and I thought it had gone bad. I understand with shipping it probably moved around a lot. I'm pleasantly surprised with this product. I was initially looking for a clean product that had no harmful chemicals in it. It's 100% chemical free which is amazing and I have an app that scans items and it recommended this when I scanned another popular brand to be "poor". It really makes my skin glow and it feels so soft afterwards. I wish the jar was a little bigger.

For 2 weeks I used this every other night-starting for 5 minutes and working up- and wow. Stubborn blackheads come up to the surface and are easily removed. I'm using it 3x a week along with the cloud cleanser and Aquarius moisturizer. My skin has never looked better.

I have been using this mask for about 1 month now and am so far really liking the results! I suffer from some hormonal acne and it has really helped prevent breakouts around that time of the month. My skin appears clearer, more even, and brighter! I also have noticed it has helped with my pores too! I was hesitant about purchasing this at first because of the price point. However, I use a brush and found a little bit goes a long way. I feel like this jar will last a good amount of time!
I love this mask! Definitely made a difference after using it!!!
I've only used this product 2x and right after all my little bumps were less red and cleared up so much .

I've lost count of how many times I have reordered this mask. I needed something to help with post-partum and hormonal acne so took a chance and bought it. And wow, my skin has never been so stable and clear since. I still get the occasional pimple here and there, but this does wonders in keeping full breakouts at bay. I recommend this to anyone who asks me what I use for skincare. I use it 2-3 times a week, 15 mins at a time. Thank you Herbivore for such an amazing product!!!

I ordered this mask after falling in love with the Lapis oil. I have extremely acne prone skin and struggle with cystic acne on the jawline and neck. This mask is so good and not drying or irritating to your skin. It really helps keep things clear and smooth. I will say to start with less time with the mask on and work your way up. It really is an added bonus alongside my Lapis oil and will continue to be a staple in my acne skincare routine.
I've only used this three times this week and it's already getting my hyperpigmentation under control. Others I see everyday have noticed and complimented me on my glowing skin. Definitely recommend!

I have actually used this mask while my skin was at it's absolute worst, and then recently while my skin is at it's absolute best. There is always an improvement after using it. The mask leaves my skin feeling very soft. As far as pore shrinking, I have to use this mask more consistently to seem but I needed this as soon as it got restocked! The blue tansy line is my favorite for my acne prone skin.
Really like this mask, shrinks pores and keeps skin clear and yet does not dry it out.

This is one of my favorite products in the Herbivore line. My skin is so bright and clear after using this mask for a few days - I think I'm on my 6th bottle of it?? I also love that it's a really easy mask to put on and take off since it's not clay based.
As someone who has had to endure acne as an adult, it's not pleasant. This mask has helped to clear it up by heaps and bounds! You will not regret this purchase!
This is my go to mask. It leaves my skin, happy, clear and glowing. It helps clear my pores and the smell is refreshing. I love this mask!
After using this regularly for a couple weeks, my skin is so smooth and the tone is more even! This is definitely a key part of my routine now.
This mask is so luxurious and smells great! The results are tbd since I've only used it twice but after each use my face glows and feels tight!

This is the ONLY gentle AND effective BHA mask I have every used (honestly rivals Paula's choice BHA 2% which can be drying on the skin imo). This plus the bakuchiol serum and the moonfruit night mask is heavenly for a once a week or two exfoliating regimen. I know my skin will be popping the next day though I'm always pleasantly surprised regardless lol
This is my absolute favorite mask ever. I use this at least 3 times a week. It leaves my skin feeling so soft and hydrated.
This is more of a heavy serum than a mask as it's pretty liquidy. It works great though and you actually don't need to use a lot vs if it were thicker. I like it!
I'm love this product and have been using it for years. After use my skin feels tighter and pores appear smaller and skin feels very clean.
This mask is the best anytime I'm having an acne flare up. It reduces my pimples.

avis.titre: Helps With Below the Skin Acne!
avis.texte: I tried this as a mini and now bought the full size. I end up with a lot of clogged pores and acne under the surface of my skin. You can literally feel your pores opening, breathing in the fresh air, with this mask. It has a cooling effect and maybe a slight tingle, kind of like how menthol feels. Plus I love the smell!
Do not buy anything else that says it has "blue tansy" in it because you'll be throwing money away. This is the end all be all of blue tansy skin care. It changed my texture over night.
This feels nice on my skin. It's only been a week but I can see results already!

I have been using Blue Tansy mask for years. I love how it feels when I put it on my skin and I love how it's invisible. I hate putting gunky colorful masks on my face - so messy. This one is so easy to apply and rinse off and it always leaves my skin feeling fresh, clean and soft. The next morning my skin always looks and feels overall better ( brighter, smoother and softer ). This one's a permanent staple on my shelf for sure.
it dries quickly after application. afterwards my skin is hydrated, soft and fresh feeling. i noticed that it dries up existing blemishes.

I loved this mask. It was potent enough to minimize pores but not irritating. Leaves my skin feeling refreshed and ready for my moisturizer/serums/creams. A little goes a long way, it's not meant to layer and be thick on your face. Just a nice thin layer covers most of your face.
Great product! I leave this on for a moment, then gently exfoliate with an exfoliating glove. My skin always feel clean and soft after using this with other Herbivore products.

avis.titre: I love this product! Amazing calm and pimple free results.
avis.texte: After being blessed with never really struggling with acne, I started to have hormonal acne breakouts in my danger triangle this year - one or two painful under-the-skin pimples every week or so. In a bit of a panic I started exfoliating aggressively (don't do that!) and my pores on my nose had gotten huge. Along with changing my diet to balance hormones and this mask, my skin is now acne free again and my pores are smaller! This mask is so gentle and light, and is just a lovely addition to my bedtime ritual all around. I think it smells really good, too. The jar lasts a long time, too - after about a month I haven't noticed much of a dent in the container - you don't need too much product at a time. My skin feels so clean and light each day.
This has a dreamy/earthy smell, applied easily on my skin, and left my face smooth and glowing. 10 out of 10, an absolute rockstar.
This is my holy grail skin product. It has done wonders for my skin. I tell all of my friends to get it.
Love this and the fact that the instructions said use every other day for the first week or so and then once a week to maintain! I completely agree with that for use, it helped a lot!

avis.titre: Excellent mask for sensitive skin in need of a smooth exfoli
avis.texte: I've been using this mask for years, and I regularly recommend it to my clients. I am an Illinois licensed esthetician.

I am a repeat customer of this and several Herbivore products. This mask is refreshing and invigorating and leaves my 'senior citizen' complexion looking its best. My results are clearer and smoother skin, well hydrated skin, and even tone. Love the purity and all the natural ingredients in this and all Herbivore products. The fragrance is truly unique and amazing! Thank you again, Herbivore!
Clears skin better than any other mask I've tried. Not drying.

This mask was perfect for my acne prone skin! It smells beautiful, feels great on my face during application and after, and helps smooth out texture (closed comdones) and prevent / reduce acne. I think this mask has really helped clear up my face.
This mask is amazing. It makes my skin look beautiful and helps clear up break outs

Blue Tansy is one of my go to, favorite ingredients for skin. I sleep with a very thin layer of this on my face and neck twice a week. I wake up with great evenness and bit of a glow. It helps squash breakouts as well!

This is my current holy grail product. I use it 3 times a week and it helps reduce my stubborn adult acne and rosacea. I especially love the results the day after I've used the mask - I wake up and my skin is noticeably brighter. It also feels & smells wonderful. Well worth the price.

This is my third time purchasing the blue tansy mask…and not my last. I feel like I can see a difference in the size of my pores and love the refreshing, tingly feel. Also, really appreciate how gentle it is on my skin.
I have acne and wanted a mask that wasn't clay or dried my skin out. This mask met my needs, i finish it off with the Tansy oil before bed for that final touch!

Blue Tansy Mask feels light, delicate and draws out the toxins. It provides gentle exfoliation and reduction of blemishes and pores. I follow it with Lapis oil for radical softness, hydration and calming.

I was looking for a new face routine as I was using a different product that was simply not working for me anymore. My sister told me about herbivore, specifically blue tansy that had helped to even out her skin. My skin is combination, but mostly on the oily side. I have an issue with blackheads and acne in general. I tried it and was actually surprised at how much clearer my skin looked and felt in just a couple of weeks. I am in love with this product and on my 3rd jar. I use it every 2-3 nights. Now my routine is herbivore Pink Cloud Cleanser, Aquarius Pore Purifying Cream, Blue Tansy Mask, and Moon Fruit Retinol Alternative Serum.

If you consistently use this you will notice such a positive change in skin! This once to two times weekly combined with lapis oil and B serum have 100% changed my life. I buy two at a time so I always have one in backstock!
This is my go-to whenever I feel a breakout coming on. It calms and soothes my skin and has prevented a break out or two!
I love this mask. It leaves my skin feeling baby soft! Going to be sure and keep it as a staple in my routine
I really like the way this mask makes my face feel after use. A little tingly, and much fresher.
i love using the Blue Tansy after ive cleaned my face it's refreshing makes my skin feel light and more cleaner pores look tighter, thankyou for a beautiful cooling product.
I love this mask for regular use. It's a nice little skin reset and not too harsh on the skin.

So I wasn't sure how my skin was going to react to this mask since it can be on the sensitive side but I thoroughly believe that it's been a miracle for my skin! I've been using the mask twice a week and it's been helping my pores clear up. Its a really great mask!

avis.titre: My PROBLEM skin is looking younger and more even toned!!!
avis.texte: I'm almost 40, I have dark circles, enlarged pores, sun damage ( from growing up in Az) fine lines, oily and dry patches.. using this a couple times and I see a difference!! I will continue to use this mask and post before and after pictures. My skin tone has evened out so much I've just been spot concealing and not wearing a full face of foundation. I've always been a full face of makeup just to leave the house kind of lady, this summer is going to be so different, I've never felt this confident in my skin, THANK YOU SO VERY MUCH, this jar is simply freedom in my life❤️❤️❤️

WOW! I do not even know where to start. This product is excellent. I have never liked my skin, my cheeks were always filled with blackheads and I had very large pores and so much texture. I have used many different kinds of masks and skin care before, but I never had results like this. My pores are almost completely gone within less than a week of using it. I am OBSESSED with it. I went from always complaining about my skin to feeling pride in my appearance in only 4 days of using this mask. I can't wait to see what continued use does. 10/10 recommend for anyone with bumpy, clogged skin with large pores. You will be astounded!

avis.titre: Why aren't the directions on the product?
avis.texte: I love the product itself; I've been using for two months and whenever I forget to use it for a bit, I can absolutely tell. I can never remember how long any given mask is supposed to stay on or whether it is a thick or thin layer mask and it drives me mad that all herbivore products, including full size, do not have directions on them.
I've been using this mask for a couple of months now and it's simply the best! I will never use any other facial. It makes your skin so soft and shiny!
This is the best resurfacing mask I have ever used. I will buy this for the rest of my life!

avis.titre: this product is wow just wow
avis.texte: although i didn't purchase directly from this website, i was able to acummulate 2 jars from bundles that i had purchased, moral of the story is that this product is just wow, i have so much to say. so lets start off by saying, it leaves my skin super soft, glowing and lighter, it also does work for the pores. i use this when i think my pores look huge.

avis.titre: Face looked brighter and lighter after 3 uses
avis.texte: I was honestly shocked by how well this works. My sister got like a big sample from some sampler kit and after a week she was raving about it. I took a look at her skin and it looked pore-less and really light. I started using it thereafter and started incorporating it into my routine. One of the benefits of this mask is that it's not uncomfortable unlike most masks out there. I mean beauty is pain right? But not this mask. Anyways, I know it's expensive but if you can afford it this is worth the money.

Hands down one of the best mask i've ever tried. I got it as a sample and wow I'm amazed how it leave your skin so cool and refresh. Let me tell you I've been struggling with acne from past 10 years nothing can calm and reduced the redness from my skin the way this mask does. Its like a gel-liquidity consistency and a little goes a long way. I'm such in love with this mask and herbivores other products.

I love the smell of this, I love the texture of this, The color can definitely vary from a blue to a black but that doesn't bother me whatsoever. I like to use this mask at night before I go to bed and I'll moisturize after, my skin always feels so great afterwards and tight and refreshed.

I was hesitant to try this as the lapis facial oil didn't do too much for me but this facial is AMAZING! I have hormonal acne and uneven skin tone from past acne. It has really helped treat my acne, prevent new acne & even my skin tone. Also for post beach day!
This mask has helped clear up my hormonal acne! Not only that, but my face seems to be smoother in texture after a few uses.

I purchased other products and decided to get a sample of this. The first night I used it It right away left my skin feeling soft, clean and hydrated. I followed with a gua sha session using the lapis oil a few minutes later. I am already in love with the way the Lapis oil has made my face stay clear and feel great so knowing that this mask is recommended to use with the lapis oil gave me confidence in the product. I am looking forward to my next mask session .

I recently splurged on a bunch of Herbivore products I've been dying to try, and I am sooo glad I did. I used this mask a couple of nights ago and the impact it had on my skin's tone and texture was immediate. I deal with small amounts of hormonal acne and oily skin, and it's abundantly clear that I've found the perfect mask to balance my skin. A little goes a long way (which seems to be the case with every Herbivore product in my collection) so I wouldn't stress about the cost. This, the Lapis oil and the brightening mask have dramatically improved my skin in a vert short time. Couldn't be happier!

I'm not big in reviews but I have literally tried everything and have been seeing a dermatologist for years and nothing has been as effective. I do have sensitive, combination skin and have had many issues but if you're not sure to invest the $$....you should. If you're like me you've already invested hundreds if not thousands on skin care products that fail. I will forever be grateful for this line of products. This mask specifically. If you're not ready to make the investment- get the sample box. That's what I did and haven't looked back since. Highly recommend.

I have tried many herbivore products and only a few do I consider essential. This product is one of them. NO, I do NOT have oily skin at all. I've struggled with a blemish here and there but nothing crazy but I still use and adore this stuff.. This mask is amazing because after 20 minutes I see and feel a difference. I use the lapis oil after and it is absolutely divine. I feel like I am being pampered every single time.
This mask is amazing. I have acne prone skin and this helps to keep that at bay. Smells amazing and makes my face feel fresh. About to start my 3rd jar of it. If you are on the fence, do it.

My skin has fallen head over heels in love with this stuff and this whole product line. There's nothing I don't recommend. This made my rosacea disappear in one use and made me look like I had a blur filter on... I'm infatuated with this literally everything.

avis.titre: You'll Never Need Another Face Mask
avis.texte: The best face mask I've ever used!!! I've been using a couple times a week for the last month and my skin has never felt better. I regularly breakout around my chin and forehead but I've had maybe one or two zits over the last month. My skin is so much softer. Highly recommend this product!!

This was one of the first Herbivore products I purchased almost 5 years ago, and I haven't stopped using it since! I am a healthcare worker, and when COVID first began I started getting terrible "mask-ne". I started using this mask then 2-3 times weekly and it totally turned my skin around. I recommend this to anyone looking for a gentle exfoliating and soothing treatment!

avis.titre: I didn't know I could have skin like this!
avis.texte: This mask was purchased on a whim, but it has absolutely changed the entire surface of my skin! My pores are smaller and cleaner. My skin is incredibly smooth and clear. I have rosacea with occasional acne, and since I've been using this mask, it's finally gotten under control! I don't even want to wear foundation anymore. HIGHLY recommend!

Yes this mask is as amazing as everyone says it is! I was apprehensive but now I'm in love. It is so effective and yet does not burn or anything intense as some acids can. Definitely a bit weird of a texture but you get used to it. Follow instructions though and remove with a towel and it goes a lot smoother than trying to rinse with water and has better results overall. It won't take away all your pimples in one use or anything, but it will make your face feel tight and clean and magical. It's stronger than you think so I wouldn't use everyday- I do about 2-3x a week. Really a beautiful product will definitely continue to buy.

This thing is a miracle cure! I love everything about Hervibore, but this is a truly mind-blowing product. I noticed immediate results after using it-- I had been struggling with red, bumpy, flaky irritation around my eyes and nose/mouth-- the first, likely a bad reaction to a new makeup, the second, classic maskne. This mask was so pleasant and luxurious to use, and I noticed significant improvement in my skin as soon as I rinsed it off. My skin continued to improve as the afternoon went on. I used a little bit of the resurfacing serum and a probiotic cream afterwards, but I think these results can be attributed to the mask! Can't wait to keep using it and enjoy flawless, radiant results.

I have only used this mask 4 times now (box says to do 3-4 times in a row then lower from there). I can feel the difference in my skin. I had gotten two decent size pimples the day I got the face mask and I'm amazed at how quickly they went away! My skin tone has evened out and my face just feels cleaner and smoother. I pair it with the charcoal face wash bar and the retinol alternative. Absolutely love!!

I have blemish prone, combination skin. When I started using it, my face was covered in hormonal acne (~12 distinct bumps) along my jaw and cheeks. After using it the first night, I noticed existing acne was noticeably less red and no new acne formed. Every night I used it, my acne became less and less noticeable - by the 4th use, my face was clear for the first time in years!! I now continue to use it as directed (2-3 times a week) and my skin is stays blemish free 95% of the time (an improvement from 0% of the time). I hadn't changed anything else in my skin routine during this time, so I know this mask is the reason for my clearer, smoother skin. It's become the most essential skin product I own.
This is probably the best money I've ever spent on skin care. It leaves my skin refreshed and soft and really helps to get rid of impurities.
Can't live without it, the oil comes down my redness from rosacea i add to mask but manly that blue-green oil

Absolutely love this product! I've been struggling with skin problems for years. I have really oily skin which is a blessing and a curse because no wrinkles but acne. I'm just glad I FINALLY found something to even out my skin.

I had been breaking out recently on my cheeks and chin due to frequent mask wearing. Using this product a few times per week made such a difference in clearing the acne up! The mask also smells amazing and using it is a lovely way to make time for self-care.

I really loved how with the first use of Blue tansy mask I saw a difference in my skin . My goal is to shrink my pores an have even smoother skin; an this actually works for me. I use it now every other day an I really love the smell too.
LOVE everything about this mask. It smells heavenly, looks like a jewel, feels amazing and makes my stressed skin feel and look so much better.

I notice a huge difference in my skin after using this product. I was using the ordinary peel, but that stuff is just so harsh. Not to mention, it's unpleasant to use. This stuff has a similar ,if not better, effect on my skin without the harshness.
Mask is pretty effective but the smell is a cross between a urinal cake and a port-a-potty.
